title: External sandbox pattern for coding agents gains three implementations
summary: Simon Willison and Prime Radiant released three server implementations of an external sandbox pattern for coding agents, in which agent-run code executes in a dedicated sandbox while the agent stays outside it. The options are external-sandbox-v86, a Node.js server running Alpine Linux under v86 in WebAssembly; external-sandbox-container, a Python server running Alpine Linux in an Apple Containers instance; and external-sandbox-quicksand, a Python server using Microsoft&\#x27;s Quicksand library, which bundles QEMU and Alpine Linux. All expose the same localhost API, so Pi, Claude Code, or Codex can be configured to send code-execution calls to the sandbox, and they include an optional HTTP/HTTPS allow-list proxy plus credential replacement for authenticated API calls without sharing the secret with the agent.
